actions: **If you are running 2.1.0, 2.1.1 or 2.2.0, update to this release.** Those versions carry a security policy that stops the admin interface's JavaScript from running: the theme switcher, tabs, dialogs and the sidebar all stop responding, and the keyboard-shortcuts panel appears stuck open over the page. Nothing is lost or exposed — the interface is simply unusable until this release. Going straight from 2.0.x to 2.2.1 avoids it entirely.
fixes: **The admin interface works again under the new security policy.** The Content-Security-Policy added in 2.1.0 blocked the way the admin theme evaluates its own interface code, so every interactive element failed silently in the browser. The policy now permits it. Protection against loading outside code and against sending your data to another site is unchanged. ---
